items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Most projects are completed in 3–6 weeks, depending on scope and how quickly content is provided. The audit and proposal phase takes 1–2 weeks, then build and launch takes 2–4 weeks.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Batumi?
items.a: Yes. I focus on Batumi-based businesses in hospitality, medical, and beauty, and I can support projects across Georgia when the website needs multilingual content for international visitors.

items.q: What if I already have a website?
items.a: I start every engagement with a website audit. If your existing site can be improved, I'll tell you exactly what needs fixing. If it makes more sense to rebuild, I'll explain why with clear reasoning — no pressure either way.

items.q: Can you help with content and photos?
items.a: I handle content strategy, copywriting, and image optimization as part of every project. For high-end photography and video, I partner with local professionals. I never use generic stock photos as primary visuals.

items.q: What's included in the monthly fee?
items.a: Hosting management, security updates, performance monitoring, minor content updates, and priority support. Think of it as a retainer that keeps your site fast, secure, and current — without surprise invoices.

items.q: Do you offer SEO services?
items.a: Technical SEO, local SEO setup (Google Business Profile), structured data implementation, and performance optimization are included in every project. For ongoing content SEO and paid advertising, I can recommend trusted partners.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Batumi Lighthouse ("we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacy.data_collection_body:
We may collect the following types of personal data:

• Contact form data: name, email address, phone number when provided, business type, website URL, budget range, project goals, timeline, and message content.
• Audit request data: name, business name, email address, sector, website URL, and any optional notes you provide.
• Usage data: pages visited, time spent on pages, and general navigation patterns collected through privacy-respecting analytics.
• Device and security data: browser type, operating system, screen resolution, IP-derived request information, honeypot results, and reCAPTCHA verification signals used to protect forms from abuse.

Contact and audit form submissions are stored in our database, used to respond to your request, and may be included in internal email notifications so our team can follow up.
privacy.cookies_body: We use essential cookies to ensure the website functions properly. We may also use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our site. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings at any time. We do not use advertising cookies or sell data to third-party advertisers.
privacy.third_party_body:
We may use the following third-party services that process your data:

• Hosting and database providers for serving our website securely and storing form submissions.
• Email delivery providers for sending internal notifications about contact and audit requests.
• Google reCAPTCHA for fraud and spam prevention on forms.
• Analytics services to understand website traffic and performance.

Each third-party service operates under its own privacy policy. We only share data necessary for the service to function.
privacy.data_rights_body:
You have the right to:

• Access the personal data we hold about you.
• Request correction or deletion of your data.
• Object to processing of your data for specific purposes.
• Request a copy of your data in a portable format.

To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.
privacy.data_security_body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Access to submitted form data is limited to people and systems that need it to respond to requests, operate the website, or protect the service. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.contact_body: If you have questions about this privacy policy, how we handle your data, or a request to access, correct, or delete submitted form data, please contact us. Based in Batumi, Adjara, Georgia.

hero.title: Websites that fill rooms — not OTA commission sheets
hero.subtitle: Your Batumi hotel, guesthouse, or aparthotel deserves a website that drives direct bookings, speaks your guests' language, and loads fast enough to capture impulse searches.

items.title: OTA commission leakage
items.description: Every booking through Booking.com or Agoda costs you 15–25%. Your website should be the most profitable channel — not the most expensive.

items.title: Slow booking flow
items.description: Guests abandon sites that take more than 3 seconds to load. If your booking engine isn't fast and frictionless, you're losing revenue every day.

items.title: No multilingual content
items.description: Batumi welcomes Georgian, Russian, Turkish, and international visitors. If your site only speaks one language, you're invisible to most of your market.

items.title: Poor mobile experience
items.description: Over 60% of travel searches happen on mobile. A site that isn't optimized for phones is a site that doesn't convert.

items.title: Room & offer pages
items.description: Beautiful, fast-loading room pages with photo galleries, amenity lists, and clear rate presentation — built to convert browsers into bookers.

items.title: Direct booking integration
items.description: Seamless booking engine integration that lets guests check availability and book directly on your site, with no redirect or commission.

items.title: Multilingual guest paths
items.description: Full content in Georgian, Russian, and English — so every guest finds what they need in their language, from room details to local tips.

items.title: OTA-compliant rate display
items.description: Rate parity handled correctly: your best rate is always visible, and your direct-booking advantage is clear without violating OTA terms.

items.title: Speed optimization
items.description: Sub-2-second load times across all pages. Image optimization, lazy loading, and performance monitoring built in from day one.

items.title: Analytics & CRO
items.description: Conversion tracking, booking funnel analytics, and ongoing recommendations so you can see exactly what's working and what to improve.

outcomes.heading: What this looks like in practice

items.title: A guest finds your hotel on Google in their language, checks rooms, and books directly — no OTA commission.
items.description: A Russian-speaking traveler searches 'отель в Батуми', lands on your Russian-language page, browses rooms with clear pricing, and books in under 2 minutes. You keep the full revenue.

items.title: Your seasonal offers reach guests before they check Booking.com.
items.description: A targeted landing page for your summer package loads instantly on mobile, shows the rate advantage, and links straight to the booking engine — capturing demand before the OTAs do.

items.title: Repeat guests book directly because they remember your site works.
items.description: Returning visitors find your site fast, clean, and easy to navigate. No pop-ups, no confusion — just a direct path to booking their favorite room.

items.q: Can you integrate with Booking.com and other OTAs?
items.a: Yes. I build OTA-compliant websites that work alongside your channel manager. Your direct-booking advantage is highlighted without violating rate parity agreements. Think of your site as the channel where you pay zero commission.

items.q: What payment processing do you support?
items.a: I integrate with popular payment gateways including Stripe, TBC, and Bank of Georgia. The right choice depends on your guest demographics and existing banking relationships — I'll recommend the best fit during our consultation.

items.q: How do you handle seasonal pricing?
items.a: Your booking engine handles rate logic — I ensure the website presents rates clearly and updates in real time. Seasonal offers, last-minute deals, and package pricing are all built into the page structure so guests always see current, accurate rates.

items.q: Do you support multi-property websites?
items.a: Yes. If you operate multiple properties, I can build a unified site with property-specific sections, shared booking infrastructure, and centralized content management. Each property maintains its own identity while benefiting from shared SEO authority.

items.q: Can I update room content myself?
items.a: Absolutely. Every hospitality site includes a content management system that lets you update room descriptions, photos, amenities, and offers without any technical knowledge. I also provide training and ongoing support.

hero.title: Websites that build patient trust before the first consultation
hero.subtitle: Your Batumi clinic, dental practice, or aesthetic center needs a website that makes patients feel confident — clear doctor profiles, multilingual clarity, and a seamless path from research to appointment.

items.title: Low patient trust online
items.description: Patients choose clinics they trust. If your website doesn't convey professionalism, expertise, and care, they'll find one that does — usually a competitor.

items.title: No doctor profiles
items.description: Patients want to know who will treat them. Without detailed doctor profiles, qualifications, and specializations, your website can't build the trust that leads to bookings.

items.title: Missing consultation flow
items.description: If a patient can't easily request or book a consultation, that trust you've built goes nowhere. A clear, simple path from interest to appointment is essential.

items.title: No multilingual clarity
items.description: Batumi's medical tourism serves Georgian, Russian, and international patients. Content in only one language means you're invisible to a significant portion of your potential patients.

items.title: Doctor & treatment profiles
items.description: Detailed, professional profiles for every specialist — qualifications, experience, areas of expertise, and patient-facing descriptions that build confidence.

items.title: Consultation booking
items.description: A clean, simple consultation request flow that works on every device. Patients choose a doctor, select a time, and submit — with confirmation sent automatically.

items.title: Multilingual medical content
items.description: Accurate, professional content in Georgian, Russian, and English — translated with medical terminology precision, not machine-translation guesswork.

items.title: Structured data (MedicalBusiness schema)
items.description: Schema.org MedicalBusiness markup that helps Google understand your clinic, doctors, and services — improving your visibility in local medical search results.

items.title: Review management
items.description: A review collection and display system that builds social proof. New patient reviews appear on your site, and negative feedback is flagged for your attention before it goes public.

items.title: FAQ system
items.description: A searchable FAQ section with structured data that answers common patient questions, reduces avoidable phone inquiries, and gives search engines clearer page context.

outcomes.heading: What this looks like in practice

items.title: A patient reads about your specialists in their language, trusts the presentation, and books a consultation.
items.description: A Russian-speaking patient finds your clinic on Google, reads a detailed profile of the specialist in Russian, reviews available treatments, and books a consultation — all in a single session.

items.title: Your clinic appears in Google's local medical results with rich information.
items.description: Structured data helps search engines understand your doctors, specialties, services, and local context, giving patients clearer information before they choose to contact you.

items.title: Fewer phone calls, more online consultations.
items.description: With a clear FAQ system and online booking, patients find answers and book appointments without calling your reception — freeing your staff to focus on in-person care.

items.q: How do you handle patient data privacy?
items.a: All consultation forms use encrypted transmission, and I build with GDPR and Georgian data protection requirements in mind. Patient data is never stored on the website itself — it goes directly to your secure practice management system or email.

items.q: Can you create multilingual medical content?
items.a: Yes. I work with professional medical translators to ensure accuracy in Georgian, Russian, and English. Medical terminology is precise — I never rely on machine translation for clinical content.

items.q: Do you integrate with insurance or practice management systems?
items.a: I can integrate with most practice management and scheduling systems through APIs or embeddable widgets. During our consultation, I'll review your current tech stack and recommend the best integration approach.

items.q: What appointment systems do you support?
items.a: I build custom booking flows or integrate with systems you already use — whether that's a simple calendar, a clinic management platform, or a third-party scheduling tool. The right approach depends on your practice size and workflow.

items.q: How do you ensure medical content accuracy?
items.a: I structure content based on information you provide about your practice and specialists. All medical claims, treatment descriptions, and doctor qualifications are reviewed and approved by you before publication. I provide the framework — you provide the clinical authority.

hero.title: Websites that fill your appointment book — not your Instagram DMs
hero.subtitle: Your Batumi salon, medspa, or studio deserves a website that showcases your services, displays pricing clearly, and lets clients book in seconds — all from their phone.

items.title: No online booking
items.description: If clients can only book through DMs, phone calls, or walk-ins, you're losing appointments. Online booking captures demand 24/7 — even when you're with a client.

items.title: Scattered contact channels
items.description: Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, phone calls, walk-ins — when bookings come from everywhere, things fall through the cracks. A single booking system eliminates the chaos.

items.title: No service menu visibility
items.description: If potential clients can't see your full service menu and pricing online, they'll choose a salon that shows them exactly what they want — and what it costs.

items.title: No repeat business system
items.description: First-time clients are expensive to acquire. Without a system for follow-ups, promotions, and easy rebooking, you're always chasing new clients instead of nurturing existing ones.

items.title: Service menu system
items.description: A clear, organized service menu with descriptions, duration, and pricing — searchable by category and presented beautifully on every device.

items.title: Online appointment flow
items.description: Clients pick a service, choose a stylist or therapist, select a time slot, and confirm — all in under a minute, from any device.

items.title: Pricing visibility
items.description: Transparent pricing that builds trust and reduces time-wasting inquiries. Clients know what to expect before they walk in.

items.title: Promo management
items.description: Seasonal offers, first-visit discounts, and loyalty promotions — all managed from a simple dashboard and displayed prominently on your site.

items.title: Instagram & social integration
items.description: Your best Instagram posts embedded in your site, social proof that updates automatically, and clear links to all your social channels.

items.title: Review capture
items.description: A simple system that encourages happy clients to leave reviews — building the social proof that brings in new clients week after week.

outcomes.heading: What this looks like in practice

items.title: A client sees your service menu, picks a treatment, and books an appointment — all from their phone.
items.description: A potential client finds your salon on Google, browses your service menu with clear pricing, picks a treatment, and books a slot with their preferred stylist without a single DM or phone call.

items.title: Your Instagram followers become website visitors become booked clients.
items.description: Your Instagram bio links to a website that actually converts. Followers see your work, check your prices, and book immediately — instead of scrolling past because messaging feels like too much effort.

items.title: Seasonal promos drive repeat bookings automatically.
items.description: A returning client sees your seasonal offer on the homepage, clicks to book their favorite treatment at a special rate, and confirms in seconds — no manual outreach required.

items.q: What booking systems do you integrate with?
items.a: I work with popular booking platforms like Fresha, Booksy, and custom solutions. If you already use a booking system, I'll integrate it seamlessly. If you don't have one, I'll recommend the best fit for your salon size and service type.

items.q: Can you connect my Instagram to my website?
items.a: Yes. I embed your Instagram feed directly into your site so your latest work is always visible. This creates automatic social proof — your website always shows fresh content without any manual updates.

items.q: How do you handle service pricing display?
items.a: Pricing is displayed clearly on your service menu with starting prices, duration, and any relevant notes. You can update prices anytime through the content management system — no technical knowledge required.

items.q: Can I manage promotions and seasonal offers?
items.a: Absolutely. The promo management system lets you create, schedule, and remove offers from a simple dashboard. Seasonal packages, first-visit discounts, and loyalty rewards can all be set up in minutes.

items.q: How do you help me get more reviews?
items.a: I build a review capture system that sends automated follow-up messages to clients after their appointment, making it easy to leave a Google or Facebook review. The best reviews are also displayed on your website for social proof.

hero.title: Manual website audits for booking, trust, SEO, and speed.
hero.subtitle: You receive a practical diagnostic report that explains what is blocking bookings, patient enquiries, appointment requests, local search visibility, and trust. Every finding is written as a business problem with a suggested fix.
hero.panel_note: Manual review, prioritized fixes, and clear next steps. No automated score dump.

framework.heading: Eight areas that decide whether visitors trust you and take action.
framework.subtitle: The audit looks at the full path from first impression to booking, request, call, or appointment. The goal is not a prettier website; it is a clearer commercial system.

brand.title: Brand clarity
brand.description: Checks whether visitors can understand who you serve, what you offer, and why your business is credible within the first screen.

mobile.title: Mobile UX
mobile.description: Reviews menu behavior, tap targets, page hierarchy, sticky actions, and whether mobile visitors can move without friction.

booking.title: Booking / appointment flow
booking.summary: The path from intent to request.
booking.description: Finds points where visitors lose confidence, miss the call to action, or are forced into unnecessary steps before booking.

seo.title: Local SEO
seo.description: Reviews local page structure, metadata, service/location signals, internal links, and Google-facing content quality.

performance.title: Performance / Core Web Vitals
performance.description: Checks heavy assets, rendering delays, layout shifts, and technical decisions that make the site feel slow or unstable.

trust.title: Trust signals
trust.description: Looks for missing reviews, policy information, team details, credentials, location proof, and reassurance around the transaction.

multilingual.title: Multilingual structure
multilingual.description: Reviews language routes, translated navigation, localized calls to action, hreflang basics, and content gaps across languages.

accessibility.title: Accessibility basics
accessibility.description: Checks contrast, readable text, form labels, keyboard access, focus states, and basic screen-reader structure.

report.heading: A report interface built around business impact, not vague scores.
report.subtitle: The format below is an example of how findings are structured. Scores are not used unless they are clearly labeled as example or tied to a real measured audit.

rows.issue: The primary action appears after several competing content blocks.
rows.impact: Ready-to-book visitors may scan the page without finding the next step.
rows.fix: Move the booking CTA into the first screen and repeat it after room, treatment, or service sections.

rows.issue: Service pages do not clearly connect the offer with Batumi search intent.
rows.impact: Search engines and visitors get weak local relevance signals.
rows.fix: Add location-specific headings, structured service content, and internal links to relevant sector pages.

rows.issue: Policies, reviews, and operator details are separated from the conversion path.
rows.impact: Visitors have to work harder before they feel safe enough to contact or book.
rows.fix: Place compact trust proof beside the CTA and add supporting detail near the form or booking module.

sectors.heading: The audit changes depending on how your business wins bookings.
sectors.subtitle: Hotels, clinics, and beauty studios lose leads in different places. The review focuses on the commercial path that matters for your sector.

faq.heading: What happens after you request an audit?

items.question: Is this automated?
items.answer: No. Automated tools can expose technical signals, but the final audit is a manual commercial review of the user journey and business impact.

items.question: Will you redesign the site in the report?
items.answer: The report explains what to fix and why. If a redesign is the right next step, the recommendation is scoped separately.

items.question: Can you audit multilingual sites?
items.answer: Yes. The review includes language routes, translated navigation, localized calls to action, and obvious gaps between language versions.
